reviewNotes: Reviewed all 125 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages33-35-character.json. Contextual topic/contrast は, では and には rendered わ; object を rendered お; directional 赤褐色へ, ペプチドへ and 出汁へ rendered え. Preserved lexical はっちょう, はっこうこう, はんだん, はんようせい, はんのう, はやめる, はいらない and はじめ. Corrected exporter artifact 合わせあわせみそ to source reading あわせみそ. Checked こうじぶあい, たんおうはくしょく, のうせきかっしょく, かっぺん, むぎこう, そくじょう and regional miso readings against furigana. Rendered loanwords in hiragana, percentage ranges explicitly and sequence arrows as pauses. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
